auth.description: Create a new API key in Account → API keys in the Parseur app: https://app.parseur.com/account/api-keys
description: Parseur is a document/email parsing tool that extracts structured data from emails, attachments, PDFs, invoices, forms, etc. It supports dynamic templates and table fields, and delivers parsed output to integrations (e.g. via webhook or API). This integration enables reactive workflows based on new processed documents, failed processing, mailbox changes, and more.
triggers.newDocumentExportFailed.descrip: Fires when an automated export endpoint (webhook / integration) fails for a processed document.
triggers.newDocumentNotProcessed.descrip: Fires when Parseur fails to parse a document (e.g. no matching template).
triggers.newDocumentProcessed.descriptio: Fires when a new document is successfully processed and parsed by Parseur.
triggers.newMailbox.description: Fires when a new mailbox is created in the Parseur account.
triggers.newTableFieldProcessed.descript: Fires when a document with table fields is processed, and triggers for each row (table field) separately.
